idea-plugin.name: Subscription ACP Agent
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a Claude Subscription agent to JetBrains AI chat that authenticates with a Claude.ai Pro/Max subscription.

The Claude agent bundled with the IDE is launched with --hide-claude-auth, which removes the subscription auth method and rejects subscription credentials at session start with "This integration does not support using claude.ai subscriptions" — surfacing as "Authentication was reset. Please create a new chat for the change to take effect."

This plugin registers the same official @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp package as a local agent without that flag. Nothing is patched: the package supports subscriptions by default.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or JetBrains.
